N8 Programs
Example of a task where subagents are great: I had ~90ish open models I needed to find release dates for - so I divided them up among 6 different subagents and each one did part of the batch. Any embarrassingly parallel task works great here.
@reach_vb

Subagents are GA in the Codex App and CLI, it's positively changed the way I work - go give it a shot now!! x.com/reach_vb/statu…
